summary: Blockchain Digital Infrastructure filed an 8-K reporting a firm-commitment public offering of 33,333,334 common shares at $1.65/share, raising ~$51.4M net via underwriter Lucid Capital Markets; a 45-day overallotment option for up to 4,999,999 additional shares and 5-year representative warrants at $1.815/share were also issued. Proceeds are for working capital and growth. The filing is a routine registered direct offering (S-1 effective June 4), not a special situation; there is no special-situation trigger.
